αἰδοῖος: αἰδοῖος — revered, held in respect; adj., masc. nom. sg., of a suppliant
αἰτίζων: αἰτίζω — ask for, beg; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’begging’
αἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj., epic/dialectal by-form αἰ (used before κε)
αἴθοπα: αἴθοψ — fire-faced, sparkling (of wine, lit. αἴθω ’burn’ + ὤψ ’face’); masc. acc. sg. · also of smoke, masc. acc. sg. (αἴθοπα καπνόν ’fiery smoke’)
αἶψά: αἶψα — quickly, soon, at once; adv.
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο) · also reflexive intensive gen. sg. after a personal pronoun: σέο τ’ αὐτοῦ ’and of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’from it’, after ἐκ (ἐκ δ’ αὐτοῦ πείρατ’ ἀνήφθω, of the mast) · also masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive sense, ’his own’: αὐτοῦ ἐνεύναιον ’his own bedding’, αὐτοῦ βώτορες ’his own herdsmen’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun with a noun, ’his’: ὀστέα δ’ αὐτοῦ ’and his bones’ · also intensive gen. sg. with a demonstrative and noun: τοῦδ’ αὐτοῦ λυκάβαντος ’this very year’

αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg.: ’him(self)’ · also reinforcing σε: ’you yourself’ (σ’ αὐτὸν) · also acc. sg. reinforcing an unexpressed 1st-person pronoun: ’me myself’ (αὐτὸν δ’ ἐνθάδ’ ἔχουσα ’keeping me myself here’) · also plain acc. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, after a preposition: ἀμφ’ αὐτὸν ’around him’
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg.: ’himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼν αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’yourself’ (εἰδήσεις δὲ καὶ αὐτός ’you will see for yourself’) · also masc. nom. sg., of a thing: ’it itself’ (αὐτὸς … σίδηρος ’iron of itself’)
αὐτῇ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’for herself’ · also plain anaphoric pronoun referring to a thing, dat. sg. with ἐν: ’in it’ (ἐν αὐτῇ, of the ship) · also reinforcing a 1st-person pronoun: ’myself’ (ἐμοί περ αὐτῇ, μοι αὐτῇ ’for me myself’) · also reinforcing a 2nd-person pronoun: ’you yourself’ (σοὶ ὧδ’ αὐτῇ ’for you yourself’) · also dat. sg. of a thing, no ἐν, ’against it’ or ’against her’, with ποτικέκλιται (referent uncertain: pillar or queen) · also plain pronoun, dat. sg. with μίσγεται: ’with her’ (οὐδέ τις αὐτῇ μίσγεται ’nor does anyone consort with her’) · also plain pronoun, dat. sg. after ἅμα: ’with her’ (ἅμα δ’ ἀμφίπολοι φέρον αὐτῇ, of Circe)

αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
αὖτε: αὖτε — again, in turn, on the other hand; adv.
αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
βάλλεο: βάλλω — throw, put; mid. put (in one’s mind); pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -εο (= Attic βάλλου)
βάντα: βαίνω — go, step; aor. part. masc. acc. sg. (κατ’ οὐδοῦ βάντα ’having stepped down at the threshold’)
βίας: βία — force, violence; fem. acc. pl.: ‘acts of violence’
βίη: βίη — might, bodily strength, force; fem. nom. sg.
βίοτον: βίοτος — life, livelihood, substance one lives on; acc. sg.
βαλὼν: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having struck, striking’
βασίλεια: βασίλεια — queen, princess; fem. voc. sg., address to Penelope · also nom. sg., third-person reference rather than address: ’the queen’ (πολυμνήστη βασίλεια ’the much-wooed queen’) · also fem. voc. sg., address to Arete: ’O queen’
βοῦς: βοῦς — ox, cow; pl. ’cattle’; acc. pl. · also masc./fem. nom. sg. (same spelling as the acc. pl.): ’the ox, the heifer’ (ἦλθε ... βοῦς ’the heifer came’)
βροτοῖσι: βροτός — mortal; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
βῆ: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη): ’went, strode’
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γένοιτο: γίγνομαι — become, happen, turn out; aor. opt. 3 sg. γένος: γένος — stock, race, lineage, offspring; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., governed by μετά: ’after (blood and) lineage’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of εὔχομαι: ’descent, birth’ (γένος εὔχομαι ’I declare my birth’) · also neut. acc. sg. of respect: ’by birth’ (ἐξ Ἰθάκης γένος εἰμί ’I am of Ithaca by birth’)
γαστέρα: γαστήρ — belly, stomach; fem. acc. sg.
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γενέσθαι: γίγνομαι — become, be born; aor. inf.: ’to have been born’ · also of time, ’come, arrive, come to pass’ (πρὶν δωδεκάτην γε γενέσθαι ’before the twelfth day should come’)
γνώω: γιγνώσκω — get to know, recognise; aor. subj. 1 sg. act., epic -ώω (= Attic γνῶ): ’I may recognise’
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δήμῳ: δῆμος — district, land, people; dat. sg.
δαιτυμόνων: δαιτυμών — feaster, banqueter; masc. gen. pl.
δείσας: δείδω — fear, be afraid; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having grown afraid’
διεπέφραδε: διαφράζω — point out, tell plainly; epic reduplicated aor. 3 sg. (πέφραδε), augment inside the compound
δόμονδε: δόμος — house; acc. sg. + suffix -δε ’to, towards’: ’homeward’
δώματ: δῶμα — house, home; neut. acc. pl., elided (δώματ’ = δώματα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: κλυτὰ δώματ’ ἔασιν ’his famous halls are’
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῆμον: δῆμος — people, land, community; masc. acc. sg.

δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
δῶμα: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb: ’the house’
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’ · also with opt., in a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ … ὁμοφρονέοις … γένοιο) · also ὡς εἰ + opt., ’as if’ (ὡς εἰ … ἱκοίατο ’as if they had come’)
εἰλαπινάζουσιν: εἰλαπινάζω — feast, hold festival; pres. 3 pl.
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’) · also in the idiom εἰς ὅ (κε) ’until’: εἰς ὅ κεν … μιγήῃς ’until you mingle with’
εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. εὔμαιε: Εὔμαιος — Eumaeus, the swineherd; masc. voc. sg.
εὔμαιον: Εὔμαιος — Eumaeus, the swineherd; masc. acc. sg.
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
ζωοῦ: ζωός — alive, living; masc. gen. sg., epic (= Attic ζῶν, gen. ζῶντος): ’alive’
ηὔδα: αὐδάω — speak, say; impf. 3 sg., augmented (αὐ- → ηὐ-)
θεσπρωτῶν: Θεσπρωτοί — the Thesprotians, a people of Epirus; masc. gen. pl.
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (μελιηδέα θυμὸν ἀπηύρα ’took away (my) honey-sweet life’)
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
θύρῃσι: θύρη — door; dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic θύραις; Ionic η for α)

κάλλιον: καλός — good, fine, fair; comparative κάλλιον, neut. nom./acc. sg. used predicatively: ’better, finer’

κέλεται: κέλομαι — bid, command, urge; pres. 3 sg.
κήδεά: κῆδος — care, trouble, sorrow; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κήδη)
καθήμενοι: κάθημαι — sit, be seated; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’sitting’
κακότητα: κακότης — badness, misery, trouble; fem. acc. sg.
κακὰ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., subject: κακὰ ἔργα ’bad deeds’
κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil; masc./neut. acc. sg.: ’by an evil (fate)’, inner acc. with μόρον · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (τι … κακὸν … μελέτω ’let no evil thing be a care’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a plain substantive, direct object: ’harm, evil’ (κακὸν ἀλλοδαποῖσι φέροντες ’bringing harm to men of other lands’) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive with ἦμαρ: ’evil’ (κακὸν ἦμαρ ’the evil day’) · also masc. acc. sg., predicative: ’base, cowardly’ (κακὸν καὶ ἀνήνορα ’base and unmanned’) · also neut. acc. sg. attributive with πῆμα: ’evil’ (πῆμα κακὸν ’evil harm’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with an infinitive as subject: κακὸν … βάζειν ’(it is) bad to speak’ · also neut. acc. sg. governed by ἐς: ’into evil’ (ἐς κακὸν … βάλῃσθα) · also neut. acc. sg. subject of an infinitive: ’an evil’ (κακὸν ἔμμεναι ’that an evil is’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of εἴη: ’evil’ (μή τι κακὸν … εἴη ’and may no evil be’) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive with ῥάκος: ’vile’ (ῥάκος ἄλλο κακὸν ’another, a vile rag’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a finite verb: ’an evil’ (ἐπεὶ κακὸν ἔμπεσεν οἴκῳ ’since an evil fell upon the house’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with γενοίμην: ’a bane, an evil (to them)’ · also masc. acc. sg. as a plain substantive, direct object: ’a base man’ (κακὸς κακὸν ἡγηλάζει)
κακὸς: κακός — bad, base, cowardly; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’base’ · also masc. nom. sg., attributive with a noun: ’evil’ (κακὸς δαίμων ’an evil power’) · also masc. nom. sg. as a substantive, subject: ’a base man’ (κακὸς κακὸν ἡγηλάζει)
καλά: καλός — good, fine, beautiful; neut. nom./acc. pl.
κατάνεται: κατάνω — use up, consume (epic = κατανύω); pres. pass. 3 sg.: ’is wasted away’
καταδύντα: καταδύω — go down, set; aor. part. masc. acc. sg. (ἐς ἠέλιον καταδύντα ’at the sun’s going down, at sunset’)
καταθνητῶν: καταθνητός — mortal, subject to death; masc. gen. pl. (καταθνητῶν ἀνθρώπων ’of mortal men’), epic by-form of θνητός

κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … ἐποτρύνῃ ’until … urges on’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κε πίῃ) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever, as soon as’ (ὅτε … κε θάνῃσιν; ἐπεί κε … λίπῃ) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κε … ἀκούσῃς) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κε λίσσηαι ’but if you beg’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καὶ νύ κε … βάλεν ’and she would have hurled’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κε θάνωμεν ’either we may die’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (καί κε … μαχοίμην ’I would fight’) · also + subj. in a relative clause of purpose: ’who are to’ (οἵ κε … ἀγγείλωσι ’who are to announce’)
κείνου: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. gen. sg.
κειμήλια: κειμήλιον — treasure, thing laid up, keepsake (from κεῖμαι); neut. nom./acc. pl.
κεῖνα: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); neut. acc. pl.: ’those (lands)’
κεῖνος: κεῖνος — that, that one; demonstrative pron., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνος); masc. nom. sg.
κεῖτ: κεῖμαι — lie; impf. 3 sg., elided (κεῖτο → κεῖτ’ before a vowel): ’lay, was lying’
κιόντα: κίω — go; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’going’
κιὼν: κίω — go; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
κλισίῃ: κλισίη — hut, shelter; fem. dat. sg., Ionic η
κούρῃ: κούρη — girl, maiden, daughter (Attic κόρη); dat. sg.
κρήτῃ: Κρήτη — Crete; fem. dat. sg., poetic dat. of direction: ‘to Crete’ · also locative dat. after ἐν: ’in Crete’
κτήματ: κτῆμα — possession, property; neut. acc. pl., elided (κτήματ’ = κτήματα)
κῆρας: κήρ — doom, fate of death, death-spirit; fem. acc. pl.
λύγρ: λυγρός — grievous, baneful; neut. acc. pl., elided (λύγρ’ = λυγρά)
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάλιστα: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα: ’most of all, especially’ · also ’for the most part, mostly’ (μάλιστα ἦμαρ ’the greater part of the day’)
μέγ: μέγας — great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, elided (μέγ’ = μέγα): ’greatly’ · also plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. noun, not adverbial: κῦμα μέγ’ ’a great wave’
μέγαρόν: μέγαρον — hall; neut. acc. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
μέθυ: μέθυ — wine; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg. (identical form), subject of a passive verb (μέθυ πίνετο ’wine was drunk’)
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ (the acute μέν is kept before a following enclitic; elsewhere μὲν) · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’ (οὐ μέν ’not indeed’) · also μένω — stay, wait; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (μέν’ = μένε): ’stay’

μεγάροισι: μέγαρον — hall; dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
μεγάροισιν: μέγαρον — hall, great room, house; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν), plural for a single house

μελόντων: μέλω — be a care to, concern; pres. imper. 3 pl. (also μελέτωσαν) ’let them be a care’
μεμάασιν: μέμαα — be eager, be intent on, strive (perf. w/ pres. force); 3 pl. μεμάασιν, movable-ν form of μεμάασι: ’they are eager’
μεῖναι: μένω — stay, wait; aor. inf., standing as an instruction: ’wait’ · also infinitive after χρεώ, ’to wait’ (οὐ χρεὼ … ἀλλ’ … μεῖναι ’no need … but to wait’) · also aor. inf. after ὄφελον, an unfulfillable wish: ’would that I had stayed’ · also aor. inf. complementing ἔτλη: ’to stand firm, to face’ (οὐδέ τις ἔτλη μεῖναι ’nor did any dare to stand’)
μηχανόωνται: μηχανάομαι — contrive, devise, scheme; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted -όωνται (= Attic -ῶνται): ’they contrive’
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of the person affected, ’from my …’ (μοι βλεφάρων ἐξέσσυτο ὕπνος ’sleep rushed out from my eyelids’) · also dat. of possession with εἰμί: ’who are mine’ (οἵ μοι ἔασιν ’who are mine’)
μοῖραν: μοῖρα — due share, what is fitting, portion, fate; fem. acc. sg. (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’)
μυθεῖται: μυθέομαι — speak, say; pres. 3 sg. mid., contracted (= uncontracted μυθέεται)
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μὴ: μή — not; negative particle in wishes, prohibitions, and purpose/fear clauses · also negating a conditional clause after εἰ: εἰ μὴ ’if not, unless’ · also negating a generic relative clause with the opt.: ὃς μὴ … ἐλάσειε ’whoever did not drive off’ · also ’lest’ in a warning, + 2 sg. fut./subj.: μὴ … ἀποτίσεαι ’lest you pay for it’
μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’)
ναιετάων: ναιετάω — dwell, live; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
νημερτέα: νημερτής — unerring, infallible; fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted · also neut. acc. pl., uncontracted, used as a noun: ’unerring things, the truth’
νηὸς: ναῦς — ship; gen. sg., epic νηός (= Attic νεώς)
νόστιμον: νόστιμος — of homecoming, of return; neut. acc. sg., in νόστιμον ἦμαρ ’day of return’
νύκτας: νύξ — night; fem. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’by nights’
ξεῖνε: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); voc. sg.
ξεῖνον: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); acc. sg.
ξεῖνος: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); nom. sg.
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’) · also article-like with a numeral and noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’the’ (οἱ δὲ δύω σκόπελοι ’the two crags’) · also encl. dat. sg. of a thing, ’to/for it’ (δύω δέ τέ οἱ θύραι ’and it has two doors’) · also article-like with a noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’those, the’ (οἱ πέπλοι ’the robes’) · also dat. sg. of the giver with δέχομαι: ’from him’ (οἱ ἐδέξατο ’took from him’)
οἴην: οἶος — alone, only; fem. acc. sg.
οἴκου: οἶκος — house, household; masc. gen. sg.
οἶδα: οἶδα — know; perf. with pres. sense, 1 sg.: ’I know’
οἶσθα: οἶδα — know; perf. 2 sg. with pres. force: ’you know’
οἷ: οἷος — of what kind, such as; relative/exclamatory adj., neut. nom./acc. pl. οἷα, elided (οἷ’) · also orthotone dat. sg. of the 3rd-person pronoun (= οἱ): ’to him, to her’
οἷος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg. · rough-breathed οἷος is relative ’such as, of the kind that’ (οἷος Ὀδυσσεὺς ἔσκεν ’such as Odysseus was’) · also οἷος in an indirect exclamation, ’what sort of’ (οἷος κείνου θυμός ’what sort his spirit is’)
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐχ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a rough breathing (οὐχ)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὕτως: οὕτω(ς) — so, thus, in this way; adv.
οὗτοι: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. nom. pl.: ’these’
οὗτος: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. nom. sg.
πάντ: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl. (elided πάντ’): ’everything’ · also masc. acc. sg., elided, agreeing with μῆνα: ’the whole (month)’
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg.: ’all’ (πάντα δῆμον ’all the people’) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbial: ’altogether, in every respect’ (οὐκ ἄρα πάντα νοήμονες ’not altogether sensible’)
πάσχων: πάσχω — suffer, experience; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’suffering’
πέπυσται: πυνθάνομαι — learn, inquire, get word of; perf. 3 sg. mid., with present force: ’has learned’
πέρ: περ — even, indeed; intensive/concessive particle, accented πέρ before the enclitic τε/τις that follows it; with εἰ: ’even if’
πέρι: περί — around, about, exceedingly; adv. with anastrophe (accent thrown back): ’beyond all others’ (πέρι κέρδεα οἶδεν) · also preposition with anastrophe + acc., of place: ’around’ (ἄστυ πέρι ’around the city’) · also preposition with anastrophe + gen.: ’about, concerning’ (φόνου πέρι ’about slaughter’)
πήματα: πῆμα — suffering, woe, calamity; neut. acc. pl.
πίονας: πίων — fat, rich; masc./fem. acc. pl. (fem. usually πίειρα)
πίονι: πίων — fat, rich, fertile; masc./neut. dat. sg., with δήμῳ
παιδὶ: παῖς — child, son; masc. dat. sg.
παρήμενος: πάρημαι — sit beside, sit near (+ dat.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
παραὶ: παρά (epic παραί) — beside, along; prep. + dat.
πατρίδα: πατρίς — native land, fatherland; fem. acc. sg. (φίλην ... πατρίδα γαῖαν ’his dear fatherland’)
πεπνυμένος: πέπνυμαι — have one’s wits about one, be prudent; perf. part. masc. nom. sg. (trad. linked to πνέω ’breathe’, though uncertain), stock epithet: ’prudent’
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’ · also after εἰ, ’if indeed, even if’: εἴ περ γάρ κεν ’if indeed ever’
περίφρονι: περίφρων — circumspect, thoughtful; adj. (2-term.), fem. dat. sg., agreeing with Πηνελοπείῃ
περίφρων: περίφρων — circumspect, of sound understanding; fem. nom. sg., stock epithet of Penelope · also epithet of Arete: fem. nom. sg., ’the circumspect queen’
περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’) · also + gen., of place, physically ’around, encircling’ (περὶ σπείους γλαφυροῖο ’around the hollow cave’), distinct from the comparative ’beyond’ sense above · also + dat. in the fixed idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περὶ κῆρι τιμήσουσιν ’will honor him at heart’) · also + dat., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ χροῒ ’about the skin’) · also adverb of place, no case: ’round about’ (περὶ δ’ ἕρκος ἐλήλαται ’and round it a fence is driven’) · also + dat., of the thing fought over: ’over, for’ (περὶ κτεάτεσσι μαχειόμενος ’fighting over possessions’)
πευθοίαθ: πυνθάνομαι — hear, learn, perceive; pres. opt. 3 pl. mid., epic -ατο for -ντο, elided and aspirated (πευθοίαθ’ = πευθοίατο): ’might hear’
πηνελοπείῃ: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope; dat. sg., dat. of comparison · also dat. sg., indirect object: ’to Penelope’ (ἐρέοντα περίφρονι Πηνελοπείῃ ’to tell prudent Penelope’)
πηνελόπεια: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope, wife of Odysseus; nom. sg.
πηνελόπειαν: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope, wife of Odysseus; acc. sg.
πλεῖον: πλείων — more, greater; comparative of πολύς; neut. nom. sg. (Attic πλέον): ’more (of it)’
πλησάμενος: πίμπλημι — fill; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., ’having filled (for himself)’
πολλοὶ: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl.
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’ · also neut. nom. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun (πολλὰ ... δάκρυα ’many tears’) · also neut. acc. pl., plain attributive adj. (κτήματα πολλὰ ’many possessions’) · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’again and again’ (πολλὰ περιτροπέοντες) · also neut. nom. pl. as substantive, subject: οἷά τε πολλὰ γίγνεται ’as many things happen’
πολύτλας: πολύτλας — much-enduring; adj., masc. nom. sg., standing epithet of Odysseus (πολύ ’much’ + root of τλῆναι ’endure’)
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’by far’ · also neut. nom. sg. adj. agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’much, plentiful’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial with a negative: ’far’ (οὐ πολὺ ναῖεν ’did not live far off’)
ποτῆτος: ποτής — drink, drinking; fem. gen. sg.
πού: πού — somewhere; enclitic adv., weakened to ’I suppose, perhaps’
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέφης: προσφημί — speak to, address; impf. 2 sg. (the poet’s address to Eumaeus; the usual 3 sg. is προσέφη)
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
προσπτύξομαι: προσπτύσσομαι — greet warmly, embrace, address; fut. 1 sg. or aor. subj. 1 sg., short-vowel (= προσπτύξωμαι): ’shall I greet?’
πρὶν: πρίν — before, until; adv./conj., + inf. (grave, mid-clause form) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article: ‘formerly, at first’, no infinitive · also bare adv. ’formerly’, no art./inf. · also + aor. subj., ’before’ (πρὶν … ἐπέλθῃ ’before it comes upon’) · also + opt.: ’before’ (πρὶν τλαίη ’before he would bring himself’) · also adv. with a finite verb, ’before that, sooner’ (πρὶν … ἀγείρετο ’before that … came gathering’) · also + fut. indic.: ’before’ (πρὶν … γαῖα καθέξει ’before the earth covers’) · also with a bare noun, the verb understood: ’before’ (πρὶν ὥρη ’before it is time’)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ῥαίοιτο πρὸς οὔδεϊ ’be dashed against the floor’) · also + dat., ’in addition to’ (πρὸς τοῖσί τε ὕπνος ’and sleep in addition to these’) · also + gen., of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς Βορέαο ’toward the North Wind’) · also + gen., in an appeal: ’by (your father)’ (πρὸς πατρὸς γουνάζομαι) · also as preverb in tmesis: με πρὸς μῦθον ἔειπε = με προσέειπε μῦθον ’spoke a word to me’
πρῶτα: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first’
πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’
πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usu. with a negative
πωλεύμενοι: πωλέομαι — go to and fro, frequent, resort to; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., Ionic πωλεύμενος (εο > ευ)
πόσιος: πόσις — drinking; gen. sg. (abstract noun, distinct from πόσις ’husband’) · also πόσις — husband; masc. gen. sg. (εὐνὴν … πόσιος ’her husband’s bed’)
πᾶσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl.
πᾶσιν: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl. (ν-movable)
πῆμα: πῆμα — woe, calamity, disaster; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: ’woe’
σάω: σαόω — save, keep safe; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic (= Attic σάου/σῴζε)
σιδήρεον: σιδήρεος — of iron; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic σιδηροῦς), agreeing with οὐρανόν
σμερδαλέον: σμερδαλέος — terrible, dreadful; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’terribly’
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
συβῶτα: συβώτης — swineherd; masc. voc. sg., epic -α (in apposition to Εὔμαιε)
συφορβός: συφορβός — swineherd (= συβώτης); masc. nom. sg.
σφισι: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl. pron. (= Attic αὐτοῖς): ’to/for them’
σχὼν: ἔχω — have, hold; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having held’
σύας: σῦς (ὗς) — swine, pig; masc./fem. acc. pl.
σὸν: σός — your, yours (sg.); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with γέρας: ’your (prize)’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also as adverb, ’together’, or as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: σὺν … κάλυψε = συνεκάλυψε ’covered up’; σὺν … ἔπεσον = συνέπεσον ’fell together, clashed’ · also adverb ’along, with (us)’ construed with ἔχοντες, which takes the object (σὺν … χεῖρας ἔχοντες ’having hands along with us’)
σῇσιν: σός — your, yours; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αῖς), agreeing with φρεσί
σῖτον: σῖτος — bread, grain, the staple of a meal; acc. sg.
σῖτος: σῖτος — grain, bread, food; masc. nom. sg.
τάδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τέρποντ: τέρπω — delight; impf. 3 pl. mid., elided (τέρποντ’ = τέρποντο): ’they took delight (in)’, + dat.
τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’) · also enclitic indefinite, adverbial without a negative: ’somehow, in some way’ (τοῦτό τί μοι κάλλιστον ’this seems to me somehow the fairest’) · also enclitic indefinite as an adjective after μή, accented before an enclitic: ’any’ (μή τί τοι … πῆμα ’any harm to you’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ὅπως, accented before enclitic μοι: ’any’ (τί … ἄλγος ’any pain’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ἤ, accented before the enclitic μοι: ’any’ (ἤ τί μοι … κειμήλιον ’or any treasure of mine’)
ταλασίφρονος: ταλασίφρων — enduring-minded, steadfast; gen. sg. (epithet of Odysseus, from τλῆναι ’endure’)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τηλέμαχον: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. acc. sg.
τηλέμαχος: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; nom. sg.
τηλεμάχοιο: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο, governed by ἰθύς ’straight toward’ (not by κίε) · also plain possessive gen. with a periphrasis (ἱερὴ ἲς Τηλεμάχοιο ’the might of Telemachus’, i.e. Telemachus himself) · also gen. governed by μεσσηγύς ’between’ (νηός τε καὶ αὐτοῦ Τηλεμάχοιο ’the ship and Telemachus himself’) · also plain possessive gen. with a noun: ’Telemachus’ (table)’ (Τηλεμάχοιο τράπεζαν)
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’ · also as a substantive object in a statement: ’something’ (καί τι ἴσασι ’they know something’)
τινά: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., indefinite, accented before enclitic οἱ (with ὅν: ὅν τινα ’whatever’) · also neut. acc. pl., ’any’, with an understood noun (εἴ τινά που δεδάηκας ’if you have learned any’)
τινες: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. nom. pl. (after a relative, οἵ τινες = ὅστις pl.): ’whoever’ · also indefinite ’any’ after a negative: οὔ τινες ’not any, none’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. pl. (ἀέθλους, τοὺς … ἐπειρήσαντο Ὀδυσῆος ’the contests with which they tried Odysseus’) · also demonstrative with a noun: masc. acc. pl. ’those, the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους … ἑταίρους ’the rest of my companions’)
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whose, of whom; masc. gen. sg. (τοῦ νῶι θεοῦ ὣς τερπόμεθ’ αὐδῇ ’whose voice we delight in’) · also demonstrative gen. of comparison after a comparative: τοῦ γε κρεῖσσον ’better than this’ · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ: ’from that time’ · also neut. gen. sg., partitive, ’of it’ (τοῦ μὲν ὅσον τ’ ὄργυιαν ’of it, about a fathom’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the’ (τοῦ παιδὸς ’that son’) · also article-like gen. sg. with a noun and a participle (gen. absolute), distributive: ’of the one … of the other’ (τοῦ μὲν φθίνοντος μηνός, τοῦ δ’ ἱσταμένοιο ’as one month wanes and the other begins’)
τοῦτ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. acc. sg., elided (τοῦτ’ = τοῦτο) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of εἴη: ’this’ (εἴη κεν καὶ τοῦτ’ ’this too might be’)
τρεῖς: τρεῖς — three; numeral, masc./fem. nom. pl. · also masc./fem. acc. pl. (same syncretic form): ’three’ (ἑταίρους τρεῖς ’three companions’, acc.)
τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’; may anticipate a following clause: ’this (namely that…)’ · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (φάρμακον … τό σφιν πόρε ’the drug which she gave them’)
τόδ: ὅδε — this, this here; neut. nom./acc. sg., elided (τόδ’ = τόδε)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; neut. nom. pl. (μῆλα, τὰ … κατάκειτ’ ’the flocks, which lie’) · also relative, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’, object of the verb in its clause (ῥωγαλέα, τὰ … ὅρηαι ’torn, which you see’)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’ · also ’it’, of a thing (τὴν = the clothing): fem. acc. sg. · also with a noun, article-like: τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom; fem. acc. sg. (τὴν Ὠκεανὸς τέκε ’whom Oceanus begot’) · also ’the other’, contrasted with a preceding τὴν … μέν: fem. acc. sg. (τὴν δέ ’the other one’) · also article-like with a numeral: ’the one’ (τὴν μὲν ἴαν ’the one portion’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’) · also article-like with a participle: τὸν ἐόντα ’me, the one who am’ · also article-like with a superlative or ordinal: ’the best’ (τὸν ἄριστον), ’the fourth’ (τὸν τέταρτον) · also article-like with a substantivized adjective: ’the like (one)’ (τὸν ὁμοῖον)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’ · also with a noun, article-like: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων ’of the other winds’ · also distributive, ’of the one … of the other’ (τῶν μὲν … τῶν δ’ ’of the one band … of the other’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: gen. pl. ’of whom, whose’ (τῶν ὕβρις τε βίη τε … ἵκει ’whose insolence and violence reach’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’) · also adverbial ’therefore, and so’ (τῷ οὔ τινα οἶδα ’so I know no one’) · also article-like with a noun: ’that, the same’ (ἤματι τῷ αὐτῷ ’on that same day’) · also demonstrative instrumental, of a thing just named: ’with it’ (τῷ ἀπὸ πείσματ’ ἔκοψα ’with it I cut the cables off’) · also demonstrative of a thing just named, before a preposition: ’it’ (τῷ δ’ ἐν ’and on it’, τῷ δ’ ὑπό ’and beneath it’)
φάθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided and aspirated (φάθ’ = φάτο before rough breathing): ’so he spoke’
φάσθαι: φημί — say, speak; pres. inf. mid., epic φάσθαι (= Attic φάναι)
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φίλ: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. voc. sg., elided (φίλ’ = φίλε) · also neut. nom. pl., elided (φίλ’ = φίλα): ’dear’, predicate (τὰ φίλ’ ἔσκε ’were dear’)
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: φίλον υἱόν ’dear son’ · also masc. acc. sg. predicative, agreeing with a pronoun: ’as a friend, welcome’ (φίλον ἐλθεῖν)
φράζεο: φράζομαι — take note, observe, consider; pres. mid. imper. 2 sg.: ’mark, take note’
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
χλαῖνάν: χλαῖνα — a thick woollen cloak; fem. acc. sg.
ἀγχοῦ: ἀγχοῦ — near, close by; adv. (by-form of ἄγχι)
ἀγόρευεν: ἀγορεύω — speak (esp. in assembly); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented
ἀείδει: ἀείδω — sing; pres. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ᾄδει)
ἀθανάτοισι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -οις)
ἀκουέμεν: ἀκούω — hear, listen to; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἀκούειν)
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around, about; prep./adv. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ ... βάλλομεν = ἀμφιβάλλομεν ’we threw around, embraced’)
ἀμῦναι: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; aor. inf. act., infin. of purpose: ’to ward off’
ἀνέρες: ἀνήρ — man; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄνδρες)
ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; gen. pl.
ἀντίον: ἀντίον — face to face, in answer, opposite; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’opposite, facing’ (ἀντίον Εὐρυμάχου ’opposite Eurymachus’)
ἀοιδὸν: ἀοιδός — minstrel, singer; masc. acc. sg.
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀποτίσεται: ἀποτίνω — pay back, make pay, exact requital; fut. mid. 3 sg. ’will exact payment’, or perh. short-vowel aor. subj. (the form does not decide)
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀρὴν: ἀρή — bane, ruin, harm; fem. acc. sg.
ἀτάσθαλα: ἀτάσθαλος — wanton, reckless; neut. acc. pl., substantive: ’wanton, reckless deeds’, the adjective behind the fixed noun ἀτασθαλίαι ’wanton-follies’
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἂν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also with a secondary indicative (impf./aor.) marking an unreal, contrary-to-fact conclusion: ’would’ (οὐκ ἂν ... ἀγόρευες ’you would not be speaking’) · also = ἀνά (preposition/preverb ’up’) in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἂν … βαῖνε = ἀνέβαινε, ἂν … βάντες = ἀναβάντες) · also = ἀνά as a preposition + acc.: ’up through, up among’ (ἂν δόνακας ’up through the reeds’) · also in ὡς ἄν + opt., a purpose clause: ’so that … might’ (ὡς ἂν … ἑλοίμεθα ’so that we might seize’)
ἄγειν: ἄγω — lead, bring; pres. inf. act.
ἄκουσεν: ἀκούω — hear; aor. 3 sg., + acc. of the thing heard
ἄλλο: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.
ἄλλως: ἄλλως — otherwise, in another way; adv. · also ’idly, to no purpose, without ground’ (ἄλλως … ψεύδοντ’ ’tell lies idly’)
ἄμοτον: ἄμοτον — insatiably, unceasingly, eagerly; adv. (neut. acc. of ἄμοτος)
ἄνωγεν: ἄνωγα (defective, perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; 3 sg., ν-movable, used with past narrative force (+ inf.): ’commands, bade’
ἄνωχθι: ἄνωγα — bid, command; perf. imper. 2 sg.: ’bid! order!’
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἄττα: ἄττα — father; voc. sg., a respectful address by a younger man to an older one, carrying no kinship
ἄφρων: ἄφρων — senseless, foolish; masc. nom. sg.
ἅ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’what things’
ἐθέλῃσι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. subj. 3 sg.
ἐλθέμεν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. inf., epic ἐλθέμεν (= Attic ἐλθεῖν): ’to come’
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’
ἐμὸν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’my’ (ὄνομ’ … ἐμὸν ’my name’; ἐμὸν κῆρ ’my heart’)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνίσπῃ: ἐνέπω — tell, relate, speak; aor. subj. 3 sg.
ἐναντίον: ἐναντίος — opposite; neut. acc. sg. as adv./prep. + gen.: ’in front of, before’
ἐνθάδε: ἐνθάδε — here, to this place; adv., with -δε suffix of direction (’in this place’)
ἐνόησεν: νοέω — perceive, devise, think of; aor. 3 sg.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξαίσιον: ἐξαίσιος — beyond what is fitting, outrageous; neut./masc. acc. sg.
ἐπήλυθε: ἐπέρχομαι — come upon; aor. 3 sg., epic ἐπήλυθε (= Attic ἐπῆλθε)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: ἐπὶ … τέταλτο = ἐπιτέταλτο ’was laid upon, entrusted’ · also + acc. of time: ’for, over’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + dat., ’in charge of, over’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσιν ’over my possessions’)
ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐστίν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., ν-movable form
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἒξ: ἐκ (postpositive, accented ἒξ after its noun, anastrophe) — out of, from; + gen.: θεῶν ἒξ = ἐκ θεῶν
ἔδουσιν: ἐσθίω — eat; pres. 3 pl., from the epic present ἔδω (= Attic ἐσθίουσι)
ἔλθοι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. opt. 3 sg. (wish): ’may... come’ · also in a conditional protasis: ’if ... should come’ (εἰ καί ποθεν ἄλλοθεν ἔλθοι) · also in an indirect question after a past verb: ’from where she came’ (πόθεν ἔλθοι) · also in a relative clause with κε, prospective: ’(whoever) should come’ (ὅς κε … ἔλθοι) · also in a negative purpose clause after μή: ’lest he go’ (μή … ἔλθοι ἀπαγγέλλων) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a general relative clause, without κε: ’whatever he might come in need of’ (ὅτευ κεχρημένος ἔλθοι)
ἔμ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (ἔμ’ = ἐμέ): ’me’
ἔνθεν: ἔνθεν — from there, thence; adv. of place, with suffix -θεν · also ’on the one side’ (ἔνθεν μὲν γὰρ πέτραι ’on one side are rocks’)
ἔοικε: ἔοικα — be fitting, seem; perf. with pres. sense, impersonal 3 sg.: ’it is fitting’ · also personal, ’is like, resembles’ + dat. (θεοῖσιν ἔοικε ’he is like the gods’)
ἔπ: ἐπί — on, upon; standing for ἔπεστι ’is there, is at hand’, accent thrown back (ἔπι), elided ἔπ’ · also adverbial ἔπ’ with no ἔπεστι sense (τόσσον ἔπ’ εὐρεῖαν), exact force debated · also ἐπί + dat. of cause, accent thrown back (ἔπ’ = ἔπι): ’for, on account of’ (τῷ ἔπ’ … μογήσῃ ’for whom he has toiled’)
ἔπε: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl. (ἔπεα, elided ἔπε’), epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπεσσι: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἔπεσι)
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔρχεο: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. imper. 2 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔρχου)
ἔσκεν: εἰμί — be; impf. iterative 3 sg. (-σκε(ν) suffix): ’used to be’
ἔσσεται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἔσται)
ἔχον: ἔχω — have, hold, keep to; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶχον) · also impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= εἶχον): ’I had, I was carrying’
ἕζετ: ἕζομαι — sit down; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἕζετ’ = ἕζετο), in tmesis with κατά: ’sat down’ · also plain, no tmesis: ’sat’ (ἕζετ’ ἔπειτ’ ἐπὶ θῖνα ’then sat down on the shore’)
ἕρκεά: ἕρκος — enclosure, fence, pen; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic ἕρκη), accented before the enclitic τε
ἕσσει: ἕννυμι — clothe; fut. 3 sg., + two acc.: ’will clothe (you) in’
ἕσσω: ἕννυμι — clothe, put on; fut. 1 sg. (cf. aor. ἕσσε), with ἀμφί in tmesis ’I will clothe in’ · also fut. 1 sg. with no preverb, double accusative: ’I will clothe (him) in (a cloak)’
ἠέλιον: ἥλιος — sun; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted ἠέλιον (= Attic ἥλιον)
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ) · also introducing the first alternative of a question: ’whether’ (ἠὲ διεπράθετο … ἦ … ’whether it was sacked … or …’) · also ’than’, after a word of difference (ἀλλοῖος … ἠὲ πάροιθεν ’different than before’) · also ’than’ after a comparative or word of preference (βέλτερόν ἐστι … ἠὲ ’it is better … than’) · also introducing the first alternative of a command: ’either’ (ἠὲ σὺ πρῶτος ἔσελθε ’either you go in first’)
ἠῶθεν: ἠώς — dawn; adv. ἠῶθεν, -θεν suffix ’from’: ’at dawn’
ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. sg.: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a pool of water (ἡ δὲ προσέπλαζε ’and it lapped up’) · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a ship (ἡ δ’ ἔθει ’and it ran’) · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun/adj., article-like: ’the other’ (ἡ δ’ ἄλλη ’and the other woman’) · also fem. nom. sg. article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ἡ γὰρ δμώων δίκη ’for the way of servants’)
ἡδύ: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; neut. acc. sg., attributive
ἡμέτερον: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with κάματον: ’our (toil)’
ἡμῖν: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; dat. pl. ’to us’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic ἠέ/ἤ) · also ’than’ after a comparative: κρεῖσσον … ἢ ὅτε ’better than when’ · also ’before’ after a verb of anticipating (ἔφθης … ἢ ἐγώ ’you got here before I did’) · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἔτι … ἦέ τις ’whether still … or someone’) · also ’than’ after a verb of preferring: βουλοίμην … ἢ … ἀνάσσειν ’I would rather … than rule’
ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤματ: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl. ἤματα, elided ἤματ’ before a vowel: ’(for) days’
ἤματα: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’all the days, every day’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’the days’ (νύκτες τε καὶ ἤματα φθίνουσιν)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’) · also ’or’, the second alternative of a pair of questions with no preceding ἠέ: ζώει … ἦ τέθνηκε ’alive or dead’; ἢ ἔτ’ ἔχει … ἦ μιν ἀτιμάζουσιν ’whether … or’
ἦε: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), spelled ἦε in ἦε καὶ οὐκί ’or not’
ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἰκαρίοιο: Ἰκάριος — Icarius, father of Penelope; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἱερήϊα: ἱερήϊον — sacrificial victim; neut. acc. pl., epic (= Attic ἱερεῖα)
ἱερεύοντες: ἱερεύω — slaughter as a sacrifice, sacrifice; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
ἱκέτευσα: ἱκετεύω — beseech, supplicate; aor. 1 sg.: ’I besought’
ἱστάμενος: ἵστημι — set, stand; pres. mid. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’standing’
ἴδεν: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= εἶδεν)
ἴμεναι: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι): ’to go’
ἵκει: ἵκω — come upon, reach, arrive at; pres. 3 sg., epic beside ἱκνέομαι
ἵκετο: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg.; where the metre makes the ι long, that is the augment, which the spelling cannot show; with short ι, unaugmented
ἵν: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj., elided (ἵν’ = ἵνα) · also relative adverb of place, ’where’ (= Attic οὗ): τῶν ἐνὶ δήμῳ, ἵν’ οἴχεται ’among those of the land where he has gone’
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; + subj. · also + opt. after a past tense · also relative ’where’ + indic.: ἵνα … καθεύδετον ’where the two are sleeping’ · also + opt. after a future main verb: ’so that … may’ (ἄξω … ἵνα … ἄλφοι ’I will take … so that he may bring in’)
ὀδυσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. nom. sg., single-σ metrical variant Ὀδυσεύς
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (double-σ, metrical variant of single-σ Ὀδυσῆος)
ὀδυσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆος)
ὀρχηστυῖ: ὀρχηστύς — dancing, the art of the dance; fem. dat. sg.
ὀφθαλμοῖσι: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also article-like with an adjective and a name: ’the’ (ὁ θρασὺς Ὀδυσσεύς ’bold Odysseus’) · also article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’) · also distributive, masc. nom. sg.: ’the one’ (ὁ μὲν οὐρανὸν εὐρὺν ἱκάνει ’the one reaches the broad heaven’) · also article-like with a superlative: ’the worst’ (ὁ κάκιστος Ἀχαιῶν ’the worst of the Achaeans’)
ὁμὴν: ὁμός — same, common; fem. acc. sg.
ὁππότ: ὁππότε (elided ὁππότ’) — whenever, when; epic (= Attic ὁπότε)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary-sequence verb: ὄφρα ... ἕλοις/ἵκοιο ’so that you might take/arrive’ · also temporal + indic., ’as long as’ (ὄφρα μὲν … ἦν ’so long as it was’)
ὄϊς: ὄϊς — sheep; common gender (masc. or fem.), acc. pl., epic ὄϊς (= Attic οἶς): ’sheep’
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅμιλον: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. acc. sg.
ὅνδε: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own; masc. acc. sg. + directional suffix -δε: ὅνδε δόμονδε ’to his own house’
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’ · also with τις, indefinite relative: ὅς τις … φάγοι ’whoever should eat’
ὅτ: ὅτε (elided ὅτ’) — when; temporal conj., here + ἄν and subj. in a general/future clause · also + indic., of a single definite past event: ’when’ (ὅτ’ ἐν Ἄργεϊ ... ἵστασαν ’when they were mooring in Argos’) · also + opt., in a repeated past clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂψ ἄρχοιτο ’whenever he began again’) · also + subj. without ἄν, in a general clause: ὅτ’ … ἔχῃ ’whenever … holds’ · also in ὡς ὅτ’, ’as when (a minstrel does)’, the verb left unexpressed · also in ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ introducing a simile with a finite verb expressed: ’as when’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ … ἁλιεὺς … προΐησι) · also causal + indic.: ’since, because’ (ὅτ’ οὐκ ἐθέλουσι δικαίως ’since they are not willing to act justly’)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’) · also with the optative, iterative in past time: ’whenever’ (ὅτε μέλλοι ’whenever he was about to’) · also with the pres. indic., ’whereas, when’ (ὅτε τ’ ἄλλοι ἅπαξ θνῄσκουσ’ ἄνθρωποι ’whereas other men die only once’) · also in ὅτε μή, ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ θεὸς … θείη ’unless a god should make’)
ὑβρίζοντες: ὑβρίζω — act violently or insolently, commit outrage (from ὕβρις); pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’behaving insolently’
ὑπερηνορεόντων: ὑπερηνορέω — play the overbearing man, be overweening (ὑπέρ + ἀνήρ); pres. part. gen. pl., epic uncontracted, partitive with τις
ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + acc. (ὑπὲρ μόρον ’beyond one’s portion’) · also + gen., literally ’over, above’ (ὑπὲρ ἀργυρέοιο λέβητος ’over a silver basin’) · also + gen., in an adjuration: ’by’ (ὑπὲρ θυέων καὶ δαίμονος ’by the sacrifices and a power’)
ὕας: ὗς — pig, boar; masc. acc. pl. ὕας (= Attic ὗς)
ὕβριν: ὕβρις — insolence, wanton violence; fem. acc. sg.
ὕβρις: ὕβρις — insolence, violence, outrage; fem. nom. sg.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., of manner: ’as’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I shall say’) · also comparative ’like’, standing before its noun (ὡς νυκτερίς ’like a bat’) · also ὡς ὅθ’ (= ὡς ὅτε), ’as when’, comparing with an occasion in the past (ὡς ὅθ’ ὑπὸ Τροίην ’as when beneath Troy’) · also introducing an indirect statement after a verb of saying: ’that, how’ (εἴποιμ’ ὡς … ἔρχομαι ’I might tell how I am coming’) · also ὡς ἄν + opt., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἄν τίς σε … μακαρίζοι ’so that someone … would call you blessed’) · also ὡς + participle, ’as one who’ (ὡς ἐκ θανάτοιο φυγόντα ’as one escaped from death’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν … ἔρχησθον ’so that you two may go’) · also ὡς = ’to, toward’ + acc. of a person (ὡς τὸν ὁμοῖον ’to the like’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’) · also with κεν + opt., purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also ὥς ’just as’, in ὥς περ (accented before enclitic περ) (ὥς περ ὑπέστης ’just as you promised’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic με (ὥς με κελεύεις ’as you bid me’) · also postpositive after its noun, comparative ’like’ (οἰωνῶν ὥς ’like birds’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τοι (ὥς τοι ἐγὼν ἐρέω ’as I shall tell you’) · also correlative ’so’ answering ὅπως, introducing a wish with the opt., accented before the enclitic τοι: ’so may’ (ὥς τοι Ζεὺς τελέσειεν ’so may Zeus fulfil it for you’) · also with a plain subj. (no κε/ἄν), purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς τοι δῶρ’ ἀποπέμψω ’so that I may send you the gifts’) · also ὥς accented before enclitic οἱ, of measure: ’as much as’ (ὥς οἱ χεῖρες ἐχάνδανον ’as much as his hands could hold’) · also exclamatory, ’how’, accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τις θαρσαλέος … ἐσσι ’how bold you are’)
ὧδ: ὧδε — so, thus, in this way; adv., elided (ὧδ’ = ὧδε)
ὧδε: ὧδε — here, to this place, in this way; adv.
ᾤχετο: οἴχομαι — be gone, go, have gone; impf. 3 sg., augmented (οἰ- → ᾠ-): ’had gone’ · also of continuous motion, ’went about, kept going’ (κατὰ πτόλιν ᾤχετο πάντῃ ’she went everywhere throughout the city’)
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc. dat. sg.: ’his own (son)’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which; masc. dat. sg. (δοίη δ’ ᾧ κ’ ἐθέλοι ’give her to whom he wished’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg. (same form), agreeing with a neut. noun: πεδίοιο ... ᾧ ἔνι ... ’a plain in which is...’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἄχεϊ: ’her own (grief)’
ῥ: ἄρα (weakened ῥα, elided ῥ’) — then, indeed, so; inferential particle
